description: Open Data Portal Liechtenstein (opendata.li) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Liechtenstein state administration (portal listed by the Office of Statistics). The portal page shows sections for data, organisations and terms of use; the European data portal lists 63 datasets from it, among them the official directory of roads, public transport, cycle paths, bicycle and motor traffic counts, watercourse register, natural hazard maps, water and groundwater protection zones, and building and address registers. Coverage: Liechtenstein. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: free use for private and commercial purposes with source acknowledgement, according to the listing of the portal on the European data portal. Caveats: the portal page text names no dataset groups, formats or licence, so those statements come from the European data portal listing of the catalogue (titles and description), and the dataset files were not opened; the catalogue is below the size limit used for the bulk harvest, so its datasets are not listed one by one. It can support network and hazard context for road, transit and water studies in Liechtenstein. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
